text: A report reads the orders table every morning.

text: Those checks come from one rulebook.

text: PCI DSS is the card industry's security rulebook, and it checks every system that touches a card number, or can reach one.

text: So the way out is not to check everything, but to have less to check.

text: Think of a coat check.

text: Coats go into one locked room, and everyone else gets a ticket.

text: With the ticket you can get your coat back, but the ticket itself is worth nothing to a thief.
prefix: With the ticket you can get your coat back, but the ticket itself is worth nothing to a thief.

text: Only the attendant ever touches the coats.

text: Card numbers work the same way: they go into one locked room, and every other system gets a ticket, the card token from Lesson 3, never the card number.

text: Now only the room needs the full check.
